reasons: Lake identity gives case_name_full as Knowles v. Iowa, court as U.S. Supreme Court, date_decided as 1998-12-08, and year as 1998.
Lake citations list official 525 U.S. 113, parallels 119 S. Ct. 484 and 142 L. Ed. 2d 492, and vendor-neutral 1998 U.S. LEXIS 8068.
The opinion is built around a traffic-citation stop: Knowles was stopped for speeding and issued a citation rather than arrested.

The Court discusses routine traffic stops, officer-safety measures during such stops, and whether citation issuance can support a full search, so placement on Traffic Stops as related cross-doctrine is supported.
The opinion addresses the search-incident-to-arrest exception and refuses to extend Robinson's bright-line full-search rule where there was no custodial arrest.
The court states that the two historical rationales for search incident to arrest do not justify the search in this citation-only setting, supporting a limiting role for SIA doctrine.
residual_risks: The actual search described was of the car, not only a person; the SIA Persons page context is not disclosed.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: If the target page is limited to person searches, qualify the role as limiting Robinson/search-incident doctrine in citation-only stops.

reasons: The opinion states that an officer stopped Knowles for speeding, issued a citation rather than arresting him, and that the Fourth Amendment question was answered no.

The opinion states that neither officer safety nor evidence preservation was sufficient to justify the search, and that once Knowles was cited all evidence needed to prosecute speeding had been obtained.
The opinion refuses to extend Robinson's bright-line rule to a situation where officer-safety concern was reduced and evidence-preservation concern was absent.

Treatment is outside Lens A's merits charter, but the payload mirrors the lake treatment fields: field_i_validity good_law, as_of_content 1998-12-08, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, composite_basis migration-seed, composite_basis_ref Knowles v. Iowa, varies_by_point false, and the same scope note.
residual_risks: No Lens A treatment/currency finding made.
